sync-cycle:caller.title: Requests go round in a circle
sync-cycle:caller.message: Decision service → Decision service: each waits for the next. A slow call holds all of them, and timeouts and retries multiply around the loop. Every thread can wait on the loop: deadlocked until a timeout breaks it.
sync-cycle:caller.rationale: A loop of synchronous requests is a distributed-monolith trait: none of the services can be deployed, scaled or fail on its own. Making one call a message breaks the loop.

fix.label: Make Decision service → Decision service a message

message-loop:caller.title: Messages loop back
message-loop:caller.message: Applications messages loop back to Decision service: each one is sent again.
message-loop:caller.rationale: No single filter or rename was verified to preserve the other message paths. Choose where the callback should stop, then check again.
